ontological_thesis: A single continuous yellowish-and-greenish world-suburb without beginning or end, where taking flight to any coordinate on Earth lands at the exact same runway, flower-bed roundabouts, tin-roofed warehouses, word-for-word hardware-buyer conversations, hotel mirror logic, and leaf-and-caterpillar embossed goblets—mutating exclusively the big letters of the airport sign.

canonical_stones.stone: Big letters announcing the airport name—the sole feature distinguishing arrival from departure
canonical_stones.mechanism: Split-flap and monumental rooftop airport sign cycling across 24 world destinations while runway 27L geometry remains invariant

canonical_stones.stone: Identical yellowish-and-greenish suburban facades along the airport-to-province road
canonical_stones.mechanism: Deterministic isometric stucco block lattice in sulfur-ochre and oxidized lichen-green repeating identically across every airport

canonical_stones.stone: Following the same curves around flower beds in identical provincial squares
canonical_stones.mechanism: Concentric marigold-and-geranium roundabout islands where vehicles trace invariant clothoid-circular trajectories

canonical_stones.stone: Identical tin-roofed warehouses and factory yards
canonical_stones.mechanism: Corrugated zinc-tin sheds, loading bays, and factory yards at fixed deterministic coordinates

canonical_stones.stone: First-time conversations with buyers and sellers of hardware repeating word-for-word
canonical_stones.mechanism: 6-turn verbatim hardware-counter dialogue engine yielding zero character variance across all visited airports

canonical_stones.stone: Overnight hotel mirror framing identical logic and drinking from goblets with reliefs of leaves and caterpillars
canonical_stones.mechanism: Inspectable bevelled hotel mirror ray-frame and rotatable 360-degree pressed goblet embossed with 8 botanical leaves and 3 eleven-segment caterpillars

canonical_stones.stone: Resuming flight whenever you like arrives at another Trude, absolutely the same, detail by detail; the world is covered by a sole Trude which does not begin and does not end
canonical_stones.mechanism: Great-circle flight transit engine where departureEscapesTrude === false and detailVarianceAcrossFlights === 0 across every coordinate

hard_gates.HG-1: Zero occurrences of forbidden URL/path/namespace substrings; zero console/page errors over file protocol; clean 1280x800 and 390x844 viewports
hard_gates.HG-2: 100% bespoke Trude custom hyphenated DOM tags and .trd-* CSS classes inside body; zero generic wrapper bloat; J_dom < 0.05
hard_gates.HG-3: Causal Continuum Proof: departureEscapesTrude === false, detailVarianceAcrossFlights === 0, only airportPlacardCode mutates across flights, verbatim hardware dialogue, flower-bed roundabouts, tin warehouses, hotel mirror, and leaf-and-caterpillar goblet verified
hard_gates.HG-4: Read-only Royal Plates map.png (1600x1200) and image.png (1600x1000) intact on disk and inspectable in <trude-plate-drawer> with [P] and [Z] zoom loupe
